import csv, io, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:8096'
checks={}
for label,severity in [('CRITICAL','critical'),('HIGH','HiGh')]:
    url=base+'/api/incidents/export?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'severity':severity})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
        data=r.read().decode('utf-8')
        assert r.headers.get_content_type()=='text/csv'
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data)))
    assert list(rows[0])==['incident_id','service','severity','status','created_at']
    assert len(rows)==5
    assert all(row['severity']==label for row in rows)
    assert [r['created_at'] for r in rows]==sorted([r['created_at'] for r in rows], reverse=True)
    checks[label]={'count':len(rows),'header':'incident_id,service,severity,status,created_at','created_at_descending':True,'only_requested_severity':True,'ids':[r['incident_id'] for r in rows]}
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/incidents?severity='+severity) as r:
        api_rows=json.load(r)
    assert api_rows==rows
    checks[label]['live_json_matches_csv']=True
with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/incidents/export?severity=critical%20') as r:

checks['case_insensitive_exact_match']='verified'
checks['other_severities_in_CRITICAL_HIGH_exports']=0
checks['total_CRITICAL_HIGH']=checks['CRITICAL']['count']+checks['HIGH']['count']
